offer.title: Offer calculator
offer.intro: Turn the calculation around: enter the pay you want and see what must be billed in each payout model, and which model gives the most at which revenue.
offer.metric_totalValue: Net cash + pension + money kept in my company (taxed later)
offer.metricNote: Money left in your own company or fund is not yet taxed as income, so the last option shows more than you can spend.
offer.needTitle: To get {{target}} per month you need to bill
offer.unreachable: Not reachable at any realistic revenue
offer.note: Rules for {{year}}. Per month = per year ÷ 12. “Tax share” is tax and fees as a share of what remains after overhead and the LYVAN / provider share.
offer.bandsTitle: Which model pays most at which revenue
offer.noBands: Nothing to compare: the scenario settings are invalid.
offer.sheetIntro: A one-page printout (or PDF) of the chosen model at the billing needed for your target.

sheet.title: Payout offer
sheet.headline_netCash: To receive {{net}} per month net in the model “{{scenario}}”, bill:
sheet.headline_consultantValue: To reach {{net}} per month in net pay plus pension in the model “{{scenario}}”, bill:
sheet.headline_totalValue: To reach {{net}} per month in net pay, pension and money left in your company in the model “{{scenario}}”, bill:
sheet.monthlyNote: Monthly amounts are the annual amounts divided by 12; the actual monthly withholding follows Skatteverket's tax tables.

optimizer.weightsHelp: The weights are saved with the own-AB settings and also used by the “Optimize” salary strategy.

settings.lyvanDefaultsHelp: Commercial defaults used for new calculations. Changing one also updates the current calculation if it still uses the old default.
settings.resetAllConfirm: Reset all inputs of the current calculation? Saved calculations are kept.
settings.dataLocation: All data stays on this computer. No network access, no telemetry.

error.fixOrReset: Fix the value in the scenario settings or reset them to the defaults.
error.boundaryBody: The view crashed. Your saved calculations are safe. Reload to continue.
error.loadFailed: Saved data could not be read ({{message}}). Starting from defaults; the old file is overwritten on your next change.

salaried.label: Salaried employee
salaried.description: Traditional consultancy: salary + pension, LYVAN carries sales and bench risk.

revenue-share.label: Revenue share (70/30, 80/20)
revenue-share.description: High payout: LYVAN takes a cut, the consultant gets a pot paid as salary + pension.

umbrella.label: Umbrella company
umbrella.description: A billing platform takes a fee; everything is paid out as salary.

sole-trader.label: Sole trader
sole-trader.description: Surplus taxed as business income with egenavgifter.

own-ab.label: Own limited company (3:12)
own-ab.description: Salary up to the state-tax threshold plus 3:12 dividends.

opt.retainedWeight: Optimizer: value of 1 kr left in AB

warning.BUDGET_TOO_LOW: The budget does not even cover the fixed costs.
warning.ABOVE_BRYTPUNKT: Income {{income, kr}} exceeds the brytpunkt {{brytpunkt, kr}} – 20 % state tax on the excess.
warning.SALARY_BELOW_SGI_CAP: Salary {{income, kr}} is below the SGI cap {{cap, kr}} – lower sickness/parental benefits.
warning.SALARY_BELOW_PGI_CAP: Salary {{income, kr}} is below the pensionable income cap {{cap, kr}} – lower public pension.
warning.CONSIDER_LONEVAXLING: Consider salary exchange to avoid state tax.
warning.PERIODISERINGSFOND_TAXED_LATER: The allocation is taxed when reversed.
warning.PERIODISERINGSFOND_CAPPED: The allocation was capped at the statutory maximum of {{maxPct, pct}}.
warning.SOLE_TRADER_PERSONAL_LIABILITY: Sole trader: personal liability, no employer pension.
warning.DIVIDEND_EXCEEDS_GRANSBELOPP: The dividend exceeds the gränsbelopp {{gransbelopp, kr}} by {{excess, kr}} – the excess is taxed as employment income.
warning.RETAINED_IN_AB: {{retained, kr}} stays in the AB (dividend capped at the gränsbelopp).
warning.PARTNER_SHARES_GRUNDBELOPP: The grundbelopp is shared between the owners.
warning.DIVIDEND_PAID_NEXT_YEAR: Dividends are normally paid the following year (after the AGM).
warning.SALARY_CAPPED_BY_BUDGET: Salary capped at {{salary, kr}} by the budget (target {{target, kr}}).
warning.AGE_66_PLUS: Age {{age}} at the start of the year: the 66+ tax rules are applied (higher grundavdrag and skattereduktion för arbetsinkomst). Pension plans for older employees differ and are not modelled.
warning.EGENAVGIFTER_AGE_NOT_MODELLED: Age {{age}} at the start of the year: the egenavgifter are reduced for people born 1958 or earlier. That reduction is not modelled, so the contributions shown are too high.
warning.TAX_YEAR_MISMATCH: Tax year {{taxYear}} does not match the rule set ({{rulesYear}}).

assumption.bench_risk_firm: LYVAN carries bench risk and pay during sickness/holiday.
assumption.pension_on_base_salary: Pension is calculated on base salary.
assumption.pot_pays_overhead: Overhead is paid from the consultant's pot.
assumption.umbrella_all_employment_income: Everything is taxed as employment income.
assumption.egenavgifter_fixed_point: Egenavgifter are deductible from their own base (fixed point).
assumption.sole_trader_profit_taxed_same_year: The whole surplus is taxed in the same year.
assumption.egenavgifter_before_fund: Egenavgifter are calculated on the surplus before any periodiseringsfond allocation (to be verified).
assumption.steady_state_dividend: Dividend assumed with the same year's rules and wages (steady state).
assumption.gransbelopp_simplified: Simplified gränsbelopp: no interest on omkostnadsbelopp.
assumption.owner_no_holiday_pay: The owner takes no holiday pay.
